policies.text: An electric vehicle charger qualifies for fleet grant funding when it delivers a continuous power output of at least 11 kW.
A commercial equipment item granted high-efficiency rebate status becomes eligible for municipal incentive registration provided its manufacturer warranty duration reaches at least 8 years.

An HVAC system achieves high-efficiency rebate status if it maintains a seasonal energy efficiency ratio of 20 or higher, an acoustic sound level of 50 dB or lower, a volumetric airflow rate of 2000 CFM or above, or an active AHRI accreditation.
An equipment model clear for municipal incentive registration is recommended for immediate utility catalog inclusion when rated for maximum operating pressure of 400 PSI or greater.
A power conversion unit secures grid connection authorization provided it holds valid UL 1741 compliance.
A domestic water heater gains energy star clearance if its thermal efficiency score reaches 90 percent or higher.
